meta.title: Super Workbench
meta.description: 1/2/4 real sessions side by side, one lead plus module-owner members and their own subagents, scheduled with event-driven backfill.

ui.panel.description: View 1/2/4 real sessions side by side in one main window, and watch teams, work items and capacity.
ui.pane.title: Pane
ui.pane.empty.hint: Bind a session or subagent to this pane.
ui.pane.alreadyOpen: That session is already open in another pane; focus moved there.
ui.capacity.title: Capacity
ui.capacity.full: Capacity full; the task stays ready instead of queueing.
ui.action.stopMembers: Stop member turns, keep the queue
ui.draft.placeholder: Type a message (draft is stored per pane)
ui.error.secondWriter: A second writer was detected; this host is now read-only diagnostic.
ui.error.capacityFull: Capacity is full; nothing was started.
ui.error.casMismatch: The state changed; this operation used a stale revision and was rejected.
ui.error.staleLease: The execution lease expired; the result was archived as a late result only.
ui.error.agentRequired: An exact live Agent identity is required.
ui.error.teamNotMember: This session is not a member of that team.
ui.error.serviceUnavailable: A native service is unavailable; degraded with a recorded diagnostic.
ui.notice.simulatedNotReal: This is a deterministic harness result, not a real model run.
